description: European Central Bank reference rates (via Frankfurter) since January 2025: each currency indexed to 100 at the start, so you can see which gained or lost against the euro, with the change, low and high per currency. Statistics: daily log returns (the change in the log of the rate, which add up over days) and their standard deviation, the volatility, per month and annualised (× √252), so a calm currency and a jumpy one can be told apart even when they end at the same place. ECB publishes once per working day around 16:00 CET; a month has only about 21 returns.
name: The euro against seven currencies
